name: Institutional Compliance Overdue Escalation
description: Multi-tier escalation policy for unfulfilled institutional compliance undertakings (faculty roster, endowment deposit, lab equipment upgrades).

tiers.description: Level 1: 2 days overdue. System marks obligation as OVERDUE and issues formal Show Cause Notice to institution.
tiers.actionRequired: Issue Show Cause Notice with 14-day final cure window.

tiers.description: Level 2: 5 days overdue. Escalated to Central Bureau Head to recommend suspension of EoA or intake freeze.
tiers.actionRequired: Initiate penal proceedings for regulatory non-compliance.

autoResolutionCondition: Institution uploads compliant evidence and officer verifies obligation as FULFILLED.
